turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first; who decided that?
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.
"Before you came in." The zero went in on November 3, so that's a week too late; who decided to enter it, and was Owen heard first?
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.

"Policy is policy." Then read 4.2 with me: the parent is contacted before any mark consequence is entered, and nobody called me. If the vice principal is backing that, I'll want it in writing, because I'm walking it upstairs to the principal today.
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.
"A courtesy." Under your own procedure this meeting was required before the mark went in, not after. So what do you have besides the software, or is that it?
